title: List the names of players taller than 180 cm whose average heading accuracy
question: List the names of players taller than 180 cm whose average heading accuracy is above the overall average for all tall players, and who have an attribute record on '2015-09-10'. Order results by average heading accuracy descending.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
  AND pa.XCL_131 LIKE '2015-09-10%'
GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_123
HAVING AVG(pa.XCL_139) > (
    SELECT AVG(pa2.XCL_139)
    FROM Player p2
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa2 ON p2.XCL_122 = pa2.XCL_130
    WHERE p2.XCL_126 > 180
)
ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_139) DESC
